n: 36 Inch S Series Professional Freestanding Gas Range Stainless Steel
desc: THOR Kitchen 36-inch Professional Gas Range, expertly crafted for serious home chefs. Built with heavy-duty cast-iron cooking gates that accommodate cookware of any size, this six-burner powerhouse delivers exceptional versatility—from an intense 18,000 BTU burner for fast boils and perfect sears to a precise 3,500 BTU simmer burner for delicate reductions.
hl: Heavy-duty cast-iron cooking grates that can handle any size cookware.

Featuring six versatile burners ranging from a high-powered 18,000 BTU burner for rapid boiling to a precise 3,500 BTU simmer burner, this rangetop delivers the performance and flexibility needed for large family meals and entertaining.
Built-in convection fan circulates hot air evenly throughout the oven for faster, more consistent cooking results.
